arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَالَ: أَنَا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي
transliteration: Innallāha qāla: Ana 'inda ẓanni 'abdī bī
english: Allah says: I am as My servant thinks of Me.

arabic: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ
transliteration: Mā naqaṣat ṣadaqatun min māl
english: Charity never diminishes wealth.

arabic: عَلَيْكُمْ بِالصِّدْقِ فَإِنَّ الصِّدْقَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْبِرِّ
transliteration: Alaykum biṣ-ṣidqi fa-innaṣ-ṣidqa yahdī ilal-birr
english: Hold fast to truthfulness, for it leads to righteousness.

arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
transliteration: Man kāna yu'minu billāhi wal-yawmil-ākhiri falyaqul khayran aw liyaṣmut
english: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.

arabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ
transliteration: Al-mu'minul-qawiyyu khayrun wa-aḥabbu ilallāhi minal-mu'minil-ḍa'īf
english: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer.

arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
transliteration: Lā yu'minu aḥadukum ḥattā yuḥibba li-akhīhi mā yuḥibbu li-nafsih
english: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ
transliteration: Innallāha rafīqun yuḥibbur-rifq
english: Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all things.

arabic: عَجَبًا لِأَمْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِ إِنَّ أَمْرَهُ كُلَّهُ خَيْرٌ
transliteration: Ajaban li-amril-mu'min, inna amrahu kullahu khayar
english: Wondrous is the affair of the believer — all of his affairs are good.

arabic: كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ أَوْ عَابِرُ سَبِيلٍ
transliteration: Kun fid-dunyā ka-annaka gharīb aw 'ābiru sabīl
english: Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveller passing through.

arabic: إِذَا مَاتَ الْإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلَّا مِنْ ثَلَاثَةٍ
transliteration: Idhā mātal-insānu inqaṭa'a 'anhu 'amaluhu illā min thalāthah
english: When a person dies, all deeds end except three: ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge, or a righteous child who prays for them.

arabic: احْفَظِ اللَّهَ يَحْفَظْكَ
transliteration: Iḥfaẓillāha yaḥfaẓka
english: Be mindful of Allah and He will protect you.

arabic: وَاعْلَمْ أَنَّ مَا أَصَابَكَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لِيُخْطِئَكَ
transliteration: Wa'lam anna mā aṣābaka lam yakun liyukhṭi'ak
english: Know that whatever has befallen you was never meant to miss you.

arabic: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
transliteration: Khayrukum man ta'allamal-Qur'āna wa 'allamah
english: The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.

arabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
transliteration: Man salaka ṭarīqan yaltamisu fīhi 'ilman sahhallāhu lahu bihi ṭarīqan ilal-jannah
english: Whoever travels a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Paradise.

arabic: إِنَّ أَحَبَّ الْأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ
transliteration: Inna aḥabbal-a'māli ilallāhi adwamuhā wa-in qall
english: The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most consistent, even if they are small.

arabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهِ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا
transliteration: Ittaqillāha ḥaythumā kunta wa-atbi'is-sayyi'atal-ḥasanata tamḥuhā
english: Fear Allah wherever you are, and follow an evil deed with a good one to erase it.

arabic: الدُّنْيَا سِجْنُ الْمُؤْمِنِ وَجَنَّةُ الْكَافِرِ
transliteration: Ad-dunyā sijnal-mu'min wa-jannatul-kāfir
english: This world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِيَ الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي
transliteration: Allāhumma aṣliḥ lī dīniyal-ladhī huwa 'iṣmatu amrī
english: O Allah, rectify for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs.

arabic: يَسِّرُوا وَلَا تُعَسِّرُوا وَبَشِّرُوا وَلَا تُنَفِّرُوا
transliteration: Yassirū wa-lā tu'assirū wa-bashshirū wa-lā tunaffirū
english: Make things easy and do not make them difficult; give glad tidings and do not repel.

arabic: كُلُّ مَعْرُوفٍ صَدَقَةٌ
transliteration: Kullu ma'rūfin ṣadaqah
english: Every act of kindness is charity.

arabic: لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ
transliteration: Laysal-shadīdu biṣ-ṣur'ah, innamaş-shadīdul-ladhī yamliku nafsahu 'indal-ghaḍab
english: The strong person is not the one who can wrestle others; the strong person is the one who controls himself in anger.

arabic: مَنْ لَا يَشْكُرُ النَّاسَ لَا يَشْكُرُ اللَّهَ
transliteration: Man lā yashkurun-nāsa lā yashkurullāh
english: Whoever does not thank people does not thank Allah.

arabic: وَالْكَلِمَةُ الطَّيِّبَةُ صَدَقَةٌ
transliteration: Wal-kalimatut-ṭayyibatu ṣadaqah
english: A kind word is charity.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْمَالِكُمْ
transliteration: Innallāha lā yanẓuru ilā ṣuwarikum wa-amwālikum wa-lākin yanẓuru ilā qulūbikum wa-a'mālikum
english: Allah does not look at your appearance or wealth, but at your hearts and deeds.

arabic: مَنْ صَامَ رَمَضَانَ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ
transliteration: Man ṣāma Ramaḍāna īmānan waḥtisāban ghufira lahu mā taqaddama min dhanbih
english: Whoever fasts Ramadan out of faith and seeking reward, his past sins will be forgiven.

arabic: الصَّبْرُ ضِيَاءٌ
transliteration: Aṣ-ṣabru ḍiyā'
english: Patience is illumination.

arabic: لَوْ أَنَّ ابْنَ آدَمَ هَرَبَ مِنْ رِزْقِهِ كَمَا يَهْرُبُ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ لَأَدْرَكَهُ رِزْقُهُ كَمَا يُدْرِكُهُ الْمَوْتُ
transliteration: Law anna ibna Ādama haraba min rizqihi kamā yahrubu minal-mawti la-adrakahu rizquhu kamā yudrikuhu mawt
english: If the son of Adam were to flee from his provision as he flees from death, his provision would still catch him just as death will catch him.

arabic: أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ
transliteration: Aqrabu mā yakūnal-'abdu min rabbihi wa-huwa sājid
english: The servant is closest to his Lord when he is in prostration.

arabic: مَا أَصَابَ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنْ نَصَبٍ وَلَا وَصَبٍ وَلَا هَمٍّ وَلَا حَزَنٍ وَلَا أَذًى وَلَا غَمٍّ حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا إِلَّا كَفَّرَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ
transliteration: Mā aṣābal-muslima min naṣabin wa-lā waṣabin wa-lā hammin wa-lā ḥazanin wa-lā adhan wa-lā ghamin ḥattāsh-shawkati yushākuhā illā kaffara llāhu bihā min khaṭāyāh
english: No fatigue, disease, sorrow, grief, hurt, or distress — even a thorn that pricks him — befalls a Muslim, but Allah expiates some of his sins because of it.

arabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
transliteration: Ittaqillāha ḥaythumā kunta wa-khāliqi n-nāsa bi-khuluqin ḥasan
english: Fear Allah wherever you are, and treat people with good character.

arabic: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ
transliteration: Ar-rāḥimūna yarḥamuhum ar-Raḥmān, irḥamū man fil-arḍi yarḥamkum man fis-samā'
english: The merciful are shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth and the One above the heavens will be merciful to you.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ مَا لَمْ يُغَرْغِرْ
transliteration: Innallāha yaqbalut-tawbata mā lam yugharghar
english: Allah accepts repentance as long as the soul has not reached the throat.

arabic: مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ مُؤْمِنٍ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ الدُّنْيَا نَفَّسَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
transliteration: Man naffasa 'an mu'minin kurbatan min kurabidunyā, naffasallāhu 'anhu kurbatan min kurabi yawmil-qiyāmah
english: Whoever relieves a believer of a distress in this world, Allah will relieve him of a distress on the Day of Judgement.

arabic: لَا تَحَاسَدُوا وَلَا تَنَاجَشُوا وَلَا تَبَاغَضُوا وَكُونُوا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَانًا
transliteration: Lā taḥāsadū wa-lā tanājashū wa-lā tabāghaḍū wa-kūnū 'ibādallāhi ikhwānā
english: Do not envy one another, do not deceive one another, do not hate one another — be brothers in the worship of Allah.

arabic: طَلَبُ الْعِلْمِ فَرِيضَةٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ
transliteration: Ṭalabul-'ilmi farīḍatun 'alā kulli muslim
english: Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.

arabic: نِعْمَتَانِ مَغْبُونٌ فِيهِمَا كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ الصِّحَّةُ وَالْفَرَاغُ
transliteration: Ni'matāni maghbūnun fīhimā kathīrun minan-nās: aṣ-ṣiḥḥatu wal-farāgh
english: Two blessings that many people are cheated of: good health and free time.

arabic: انْظُرُوا إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَلَا تَنْظُرُوا إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ فَوْقَكُمْ
transliteration: Unẓurū ilā man huwa asfala minkum wa-lā tanẓurū ilā man huwa fawqakum
english: Look at those below you (in worldly terms) and do not look at those above you — it is more likely to keep you from despising Allah's favour.

arabic: الدُّعَاءُ هُوَ الْعِبَادَةُ
transliteration: Ad-du'ā'u huwal-'ibādah
english: Dua (supplication) is worship.

arabic: الْكَيِّسُ مَنْ دَانَ نَفْسَهُ وَعَمِلَ لِمَا بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ
transliteration: Al-kayyisu man dāna nafsahu wa-'amila limā ba'dal-mawt
english: The intelligent person is one who holds himself accountable and works for what comes after death.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَمِيلٌ يُحِبُّ الْجَمَالَ
transliteration: Innallāha jamīlun yuḥibbul-jamāl
english: Allah is beautiful and loves beauty.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ ثَبَاتَ الْأَمْرِ وَالْعَزِيمَةَ عَلَى الرُّشْدِ
transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka thabātal-amri wal-'azīmata 'alar-rushd
english: O Allah, I ask You for steadfastness in my affairs and determination to be rightly guided.

arabic: لَا تَدَعُوا الدُّعَاءَ فَإِنَّهُ لَنْ يَهْلِكَ مَعَ الدُّعَاءِ أَحَدٌ
transliteration: Lā tada'ud-du'ā'a fa-innahu lan yahlika ma'ad-du'ā'i aḥad
english: Do not abandon dua, for no one who makes dua will be destroyed.

arabic: مَنْ تَوَاضَعَ لِلَّهِ رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ
transliteration: Man tawāḍa'a lillāhi rafa'ahullāh
english: Whoever humbles himself for Allah, Allah will raise him.

arabic: مَثَلُ الْجَلِيسِ الصَّالِحِ وَالْجَلِيسِ السَّوْءِ كَمَثَلِ صَاحِبِ الْمِسْكِ وَكِيرِ الْحَدَّادِ
transliteration: Mathalul-jalīṣiṣ-ṣāliḥi wal-jalīsiś-saw'i ka-mathali ṣāḥibil-miski wa-kīril-ḥaddād
english: The example of a good companion and a bad companion is like a musk seller and a blacksmith — one brings fragrance, the other smoke.

arabic: هَلَكَ الْمُتَنَطِّعُونَ
transliteration: Halakul-mutanaṭṭi'ūn
english: Destroyed are those who go to extremes (in religion).

arabic: رَأْسُ الْأَمْرِ الْإِسْلَامُ وَعَمُودُهُ الصَّلَاةُ وَذِرْوَةُ سَنَامِهِ الْجِهَادُ
transliteration: Ra'sul-amril-islāmu wa-'amūduhus-ṣalātu wa-dhirwatu sanāmihil-jihād
english: The foundation of the matter is Islam, its pillar is prayer, and its peak is striving in Allah's cause.

arabic: حَقُّ الْمُسْلِمِ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ سِتٌّ
transliteration: Ḥaqqul-muslimi 'alal-muslimi sittun
english: The Muslim has six rights over another Muslim: greeting, visiting the sick, following funerals, accepting invitations, returning sneezes, and well-wishing.

arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُ عَبْدٌ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِجَارِهِ أَوْ قَالَ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
transliteration: Lā yu'minu 'abdun ḥattā yuḥibba li-jārih aw qāla li-akhīhi mā yuḥibbu li-nafsih
english: A person does not truly believe until he loves for his neighbour what he loves for himself.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ يَدَهُ بِاللَّيْلِ لِيَتُوبَ مُسِيءُ النَّهَارِ وَيَبْسُطُ يَدَهُ بِالنَّهَارِ لِيَتُوبَ مُسِيءُ اللَّيْلِ
transliteration: Innallāha yabsuṭu yadahu bil-layli li-yatūba musī'un-nahāri wa-yabsuṭu yadahu bin-nahāri li-yatūba musī'ul-layl
english: Allah extends His hand at night to accept the repentance of those who sinned in the day, and extends His hand by day for those who sinned at night.

arabic: خَيْرُكُمْ خَيْرُكُمْ لِأَهْلِهِ وَأَنَا خَيْرُكُمْ لِأَهْلِي
transliteration: Khayrukum khayrukum li-ahlihi wa-ana khayrukum li-ahlī
english: The best of you are those who are best to their families, and I am the best of you to my family.

arabic: إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَبْلُغُ بِحُسْنِ خُلُقِهِ دَرَجَةَ الصَّائِمِ الْقَائِمِ
transliteration: Innar-rajula la-yablughu biḥusni khuluqihi darajataṣ-ṣā'imil-qā'im
english: A person can reach the level of one who fasts and prays all night through their good character alone.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ
transliteration: SubḥānAllāhi wa-biḥamdihi aḥabbu ilayya mimmā ṭala'at 'alayhish-shams
english: Saying 'SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi' is more beloved to me than all the sun shines upon.

arabic: كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Kalimatāni khafīfatāni 'alal-lisāni thaqīlatāni fil-mīzāni ḥabībatāni ilar-Raḥmān: SubḥānAllāhi wa-biḥamdihi, SubḥānAllāhil-'Aẓīm
english: Two words light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, beloved to the Most Merciful: 'SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, SubhanAllahil Adheem'.

arabic: مَنْ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ
transliteration: Man qāla SubḥānAllāhi wa-biḥamdihi fī yawmin mi'ata marratin ḥuṭṭat khaṭāyāh
english: Whoever says SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi 100 times in a day will have his sins wiped away.

arabic: يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ أَلِظُّوا
transliteration: Yā dhal-jalāli wal-ikrāmi, aliẓẓū
english: Hold fast to saying: O Lord of Majesty and Honour.

arabic: مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ مَظْلَمَةٌ لِأَخِيهِ مِنْ عِرْضِهِ أَوْ شَيْءٍ فَلْيَتَحَلَّلْهُ مِنْهُ الْيَوْمَ
transliteration: Man kānat lahu maẓlamatun li-akhīhi min 'irḍihi aw shay'in falyataḥallal minhu al-yawm
english: Whoever has wronged his brother in honour or anything else, let him seek his pardon today before the Day of Judgement.

arabic: يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى أَنَا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي وَأَنَا مَعَهُ إِذَا ذَكَرَنِي
transliteration: Yaqūlullāhu ta'ālā: Anā 'inda ẓanni 'abdī bī, wa-anā ma'ahu idhā dhakaranī
english: Allah says: I am as My servant thinks of Me, and I am with him when he remembers Me.

arabic: إِذَا سَأَلْتَ فَاسْأَلِ اللَّهَ وَإِذَا اسْتَعَنْتَ فَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ
transliteration: Idhā sa'alta fas'alillāha wa-idhas-ta'anta fasta'in billāh
english: When you ask, ask Allah. When you seek help, seek it from Allah.

arabic: أَفْضَلُ الصِّيَامِ بَعْدَ رَمَضَانَ شَهْرُ اللَّهِ الْمُحَرَّمُ
transliteration: Afḍaluṣ-ṣiyāmi ba'da Ramaḍāna shahru llāhil-Muḥarram
english: The best fasting after Ramadan is in the month of Allah, Al-Muharram.

arabic: إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ
transliteration: Innamal-a'mālu bin-niyyāt
english: Actions are only by intentions — every person receives what they intended.

arabic: مَنْ أَحَبَّ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ أَحَبَّ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ
transliteration: Man aḥabba liqā'allāhi aḥabbAllāhu liqā'ah
english: Whoever loves to meet Allah, Allah loves to meet them.

arabic: كُلُّ ابْنِ آدَمَ خَطَّاءٌ وَخَيْرُ الْخَطَّائِينَ التَّوَّابُونَ
transliteration: Kullu ibni Ādama khaṭṭā'un wa-khayrul-khaṭṭā'īnat-tawwābūn
english: Every son of Adam makes mistakes, and the best of those who make mistakes are those who repent.

arabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
transliteration: Al-muslimu man salimail-muslimūna min lisānihi wa-yadih
english: The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand other Muslims are safe.

arabic: مَنْ رَأَى مِنْكُمْ مُنْكَرًا فَلْيُغَيِّرْهُ بِيَدِهِ
transliteration: Man ra'ā minkum munkaran falyughayyirhu bi-yadih
english: Whoever sees something wrong, let him change it with his hand; if not, then with his tongue; if not, then in his heart — and that is the weakest of faith.

arabic: مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُزَحْزَحَ عَنِ النَّارِ وَيُدْخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ فَلْتُدْرِكْهُ مَنِيَّتُهُ وَهُوَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ
transliteration: Man arāda an yuzaḥzaḥa 'anin-nāri wa-yudkhalal-jannata faltudrik-hu maniyyatuhu wa-huwa yu'minu billāhi wal-yawmil-ākhir
english: Whoever wants to be removed from Hellfire and enter Paradise — let death come to him while he believes in Allah and the Last Day.

arabic: مَا مِنْ أَيَّامٍ الْعَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ فِيهَا أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْأَيَّامِ
transliteration: Mā min ayyāmil-'amaluṣ-ṣāliḥu fīhā aḥabbu ilallāhi min hādhihil-ayyām
english: There are no days in which righteous deeds are more beloved to Allah than these (first ten days of Dhul-Hijjah).

arabic: إِيَّاكُمْ وَالظَّنَّ فَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ أَكْذَبُ الْحَدِيثِ
transliteration: Iyyākum waẓ-ẓanna fa-innaẓ-ẓanna akdhabul-ḥadīth
english: Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the most false of speech.

arabic: أَلَا أُخْبِرُكَ بِرَأْسِ الْأَمْرِ وَعَمُودِهِ وَذِرْوَةِ سَنَامِهِ
transliteration: Alā ukhbiruka bira'sil-amri wa-'amūdihi wa-dhirwati sanāmih
english: Hold fast to your tongue, remain in your house, and weep over your sins.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
transliteration: Allāhumma lā sahla illā mā ja'altahu sahlan wa-anta taj'alul-ḥazna idhā shi'ta sahlan
english: O Allah, there is no ease except what You make easy, and You can make the difficult easy if You will.

arabic: وَمَنْ يَتَصَبَّرْ يُصَبِّرْهُ اللَّهُ
transliteration: Wa-man yataṣabbar yuṣabbir-hullāh
english: Whoever tries to be patient, Allah will grant him patience.

arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ
transliteration: A'ūdhu billāhi minal-hammi wal-ḥazan
english: I seek refuge in Allah from anxiety and grief.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-hammi wal-ḥazani wal-'ajzi wal-kasali wal-jubni wal-bukhli wa-ḍala'id-dayni wa-ghalabatir-rijāl
english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry, grief, incapacity, laziness, cowardice, miserliness, overwhelming debt, and being overpowered by people.

arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
transliteration: Ḥasbiyallāhu wa-ni'mal-wakīl
english: Allah is sufficient for me, and what an excellent Trustee He is.

arabic: لَا تَعْجِزْ وَإِنْ أَصَابَكَ شَيْءٌ فَلَا تَقُلْ لَوْ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ كَانَ كَذَا وَكَذَا
transliteration: Lā ta'jiz wa-in aṣābaka shay'un fa-lā taqul: law annī fa'altu kāna kadhā wa-kadhā
english: Do not give up, and if something afflicts you do not say "if only I had done this" — for "if only" opens the door to Satan.

arabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ لَا يُلْدَغُ مِنْ جُحْرٍ وَاحِدٍ مَرَّتَيْنِ
transliteration: Al-mu'minu lā yuldag min juḥrin wāḥidin marratayni
english: A believer is not bitten from the same hole twice.

arabic: إِذَا دَخَلَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ فُتِّحَتْ أَبْوَابُ الْجَنَّةِ
transliteration: Idhā dakhala shahru Ramaḍāna futtiḥat abwābul-jannah
english: When Ramadan enters, the gates of Paradise are opened, the gates of Hell are closed, and the devils are chained.

arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ
transliteration: Man kāna yu'minu billāhi wal-yawmil-ākhiri falyukrim ḍayfah
english: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should honour his guest.

arabic: أَرْبَعٌ مَنْ كُنَّ فِيهِ كَانَ مُنَافِقًا خَالِصًا
transliteration: Arba'un man kunna fīhi kāna munāfiqan khāliṣan
english: Four traits mark a true hypocrite: lying when speaking, betrayal of trust, breaking promises, and shameless hostility.

arabic: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ وَاحِدَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرًا
transliteration: Man ṣallā 'alayya wāḥidatan ṣallallāhu 'alayhi 'ashrā
english: Whoever sends one blessing upon me, Allah sends ten blessings upon him.

arabic: مَا أَصَابَ أَحَدٌ قَطُّ هَمٌّ وَلَا حَزَنٌ فَقَالَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ عَبْدِكَ إِلَّا فَرَّجَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ
transliteration: Mā aṣāba aḥadun qaṭṭu hammun wa-lā ḥazanun fa-qāla: Allāhumma innī 'abduka wabnu 'abdika ... illā farraja llāhu 'anh
english: No person was ever struck with worry or grief and said the dua of distress (Dua of Prophet Yunus) except that Allah relieved them.
